verdict.rationale: Poly is a SaaS file-storage product, so an interactive API reference is a fair thing to ask for. The evidence shows no such reference: probes for OpenAPI/Swagger specs all returned 404, and only CLI command docs and MCP connection docs exist. Those are adjacent integration surfaces, not an explorable API reference with runnable examples.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
